{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded') because they are not conversions
# Conversion is defined as 'completed' checkout
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Now compute conversion rate by channel and customer_segment
# Group by channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = converted_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
cross_tab['conversion_rate'] = cross_tab['sum'] / cross_tab['count']

# Pivot to get channel vs segment
pivot = cross_tab.pivot_table(values='conversion_rate', index='customer_segment', columns='channel')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) for each segment
pivot['diff'] = pivot['email'] - pivot['paid_search']

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel (weighted by segment size)
# First, get total count and sum per channel
channel_summary = converted_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
channel_summary['overall_rate'] = channel_summary['sum'] / channel_summary['count']

# Compute overall difference
overall_diff = channel_summary.loc['email', 'overall_rate'] - channel_summary.loc['paid_search', 'overall_rate']

# Print results
print("Cross-tabulation (conversion rate by channel and segment):")
print(pivot.round(4))
print("\nOverall conversion rates:")
print(channel_summary[['overall_rate']].round(4))
print("\nOverall difference (email - paid_search):", overall_diff)"}
